lines.beaver: 안녕하세요. 땀을 많이 흘리시네요. 무슨 운동 하세요?
lines.beaver_en: Hello. You're sweating a lot. What workout are you doing?
lines.beaver_roman: Annyeonghaseyo. Ttameul mani heullisineyo. Museun undong haseyo?
lines.learner: 에어로빅 수업이요. 오늘따라 강도가 정말 셌어요.
lines.en: Aerobics class. It was really intense today.
lines.roman: Eeorobik sueobiyo. Oneulttara gangdoga jeongmal sesseoyo.

lines.beaver: 수영은 안 하세요? 저는 매일 아침 수영해요.
lines.beaver_en: Don't you swim? I swim every morning.
lines.beaver_roman: Suyeongeun an haseyo? Jeoneun maeil achim suyeonghaeyo.
lines.learner: 저는 주말에만 수영해요. 체력이 좋으신 모양이에요.
lines.en: I only swim on weekends. You seem very fit.
lines.roman: Jeoneun jumareman suyeonghaeyo. Cheryeogi joeusin moyangieyo.

lines.beaver: 하하, 수영 훈련을 십 년째 하고 있어요.
lines.beaver_en: Haha, I've been training in swimming for ten years.
lines.beaver_roman: Haha, suyeong hullyeoneul sim nyeonjjae hago isseoyo.
lines.learner: 훈련을 오래 하셨군요. 그래서 어깨가 넓으시군요.
lines.en: You've trained a long time. That's why your shoulders are broad.
lines.roman: Hullyeoneul orae hasyeotgunyo. Geuraeseo eokkaega neolbeusigunyo.

lines.beaver_en: Have you exercised a lot since before?
lines.learner: 학교 때는 체조를 잘했는데 요즘은 체력이 약해요.
lines.en: I was good at gymnastics in school, but I'm not very fit now.
lines.roman: Hakgyo ttaeneun chejoreul jalhaenneunde yojeumeun cheryeogi yakaeyo.

lines.learner: 네, 힘들어요. 다음 단계는 더 어려운 모양이에요.
lines.en: Yes, it's hard. The next level seems even harder.
lines.roman: Ne, himdeureoyo. Daeum dangyeneun deo eoryeoun moyangieyo.

lines.beaver: 다음 단계요? 저기 저녁 반 사람이 정말 많네요.
lines.beaver_en: The next level? The evening class there has so many people.
lines.beaver_roman: Daeum dangyeyo? Jeogi jeonyeok ban sarami jeongmal manneyo.
lines.learner: 네, 저녁 반은 인기가 많은 모양이에요.
lines.en: Yes, the evening class seems very popular.
lines.roman: Ne, jeonyeok baneun ingiga maneun moyangieyo.

lines.beaver_en: What do you usually do after working out?
lines.learner: 찜질방에 가요. 땀을 빼면 몸이 가벼워져요.
lines.en: I go to a sauna. Sweating makes my body feel light.
lines.roman: Jjimjilbange gayo. Ttameul ppaemyeon momi gabyeowojyeoyo.

lines.beaver: 찜질방이요? 이 근처에 좋은 데가 있어요?
lines.beaver_en: A sauna? Is there a good one nearby?
lines.beaver_roman: Jjimjilbangiyo? I geuncheoe joeun dega isseoyo?
lines.learner: 역 앞 찜질방이 깨끗한 모양이에요. 리뷰가 좋아요.
lines.en: The one by the station seems clean. It has good reviews.
lines.roman: Yeogap jjimjilbangi kkaekkeutan moyangieyo. Ribyuga joayo.

lines.beaver_en: Then shall we go together today?
lines.learner: 좋아요. 수영 훈련 이야기도 더 듣고 싶어요.
lines.en: Sure. I'd like to hear more about your swim training too.
lines.roman: Joayo. Suyeong hullyeon iyagido deo deutgo sipeoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Great. Let's meet at the entrance after showering.
lines.learner: 네, 십 분 후에 입구에서 뵐게요.
lines.en: Okay, see you at the entrance in ten minutes.
lines.roman: Ne, sip bun hue ipgueseo boelgeyo.
